About Me

I don't just market businesses.
I build them.

I'm a digital marketer, brand strategist, and content creator focused on helping local businesses build strong brands and generate consistent leads through digital marketing.

My work combines Brand Building, Performance Marketing, Social Media, Content Strategy, SEO, AI Tools, and Business Growth Systems. Instead of creating posts, I build complete marketing systems that attract customers, increase sales, and grow businesses sustainably.

I founded RN Scale Studio to be the kind of marketing partner I'd want myself — one that thinks about business growth, not just impressions.

📚 Student & entrepreneur — already working with real businesses and generating real, measurable results.
